usage: __main__.py [-h] --model {ouro-2.6b,ouro-1.4b,huginn-3.5b}
                   --target-path TARGET_PATH [--device DEVICE]
                   [--dtype {float32,bfloat16}] [--max-seq MAX_SEQ] --teachers
                   TEACHERS [--manifest MANIFEST] [--stage STAGE] --out OUT
                   [--draft-config DRAFT_CONFIG] [--epochs EPOCHS]
                   [--micro-batch MICRO_BATCH] [--accumulation ACCUMULATION]
                   [--num-anchors NUM_ANCHORS]
                   [--attention {sdpa,flex_attention}] [--checkpoint-layers]
                   [--save-every SAVE_EVERY] [--resume RESUME]
                   [--max-updates MAX_UPDATES] [--stop-after STOP_AFTER]

Portable DFlash training with frozen targets, FP32 masters and resumable DDP.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model {ouro-2.6b,ouro-1.4b,huginn-3.5b}
  --target-path TARGET_PATH
                        Local HF snapshot, including its model implementation
                        and tokenizer
  --device DEVICE       cpu, cuda, or cuda:N
  --dtype {float32,bfloat16}
  --max-seq MAX_SEQ
  --teachers TEACHERS
  --manifest MANIFEST
  --stage STAGE         Split key in the optional manifest
  --out OUT
  --draft-config DRAFT_CONFIG
                        Defaults to Huginn 332.6M or target-width Ouro config
  --epochs EPOCHS
  --micro-batch MICRO_BATCH
  --accumulation ACCUMULATION
  --num-anchors NUM_ANCHORS
  --attention {sdpa,flex_attention}
  --checkpoint-layers
  --save-every SAVE_EVERY
  --resume RESUME       New portable trainer checkpoint directory
  --max-updates MAX_UPDATES
                        Bounded experiment; recorded as such
  --stop-after STOP_AFTER
                        Checkpoint and stop without changing the LR schedule
